title: Nourishing Gooey Indian Paneer Curry
description: A rich and comforting Hyderabadi-style paneer curry made with a soffritto base and a hint of ayurvedic spices.

ingredients.name: Paneer
ingredients.notes: store-bought or homemade paneer works well here

instructions: Heat the ghee or oil in a large saucepan over medium heat.
Add the cumin seeds and let them sizzle for a few seconds.
Add the onion, ginger, and garlic and saut6 until the onion is lightly browned.
Add the coriander powder, turmeric powder, and red chili powder and stir for 1 minute.
Add the paneer and stir to coat with the spice mixture.
Pour in the milk and stir to combine.
Bring the mixture to a simmer and cook until the sauce has thickened and the paneer is coated, about 10-12 minutes.
Transfer the curry to a mason jar or individual serving jar and let it cool to room temperature.
Refrigerate the curry for at least 30 minutes before serving.
Serve the curry chilled, garnished with chopped cilantro or scallions if desired.
